findings.claim: The new real-tree test asks the OS for the temp directory directly instead of using the project platform path helper, violating a blocking constraint.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';` and later uses `mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'versions-toml-'))`; constraint `os-locations-only-via-platform` says "Only lib/platform/paths.mjs asks the OS where things live; every other module and test uses the helpers" and its check covers `rules/*.mjs`.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the direct `node:os` `tmpdir()` use with the repository's temp-directory helper from `lib/platform/paths.mjs`, or add an appropriate helper there and consume it from this test.
